description: This file defines a custom matcher 'HaveExactElementsMatcher' for the Gomega testing framework, used to verify that a collection has exactly the specified elements, with detailed failure messages.

classes.name: HaveExactElementsMatcher
classes.description: A matcher that checks if a collection contains exactly the specified elements.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Performs the matching logic to verify if the actual collection has the exact elements.

methods.name: FailureMessage
methods.description: Generates a detailed failure message indicating mismatches, missing, or extra elements.

methods.name: NegatedFailureMessage
methods.description: Generates a failure message for the negated case.

methods.name: resetState
methods.description: Resets internal state before a new match attempt.
